name: Arlan
text: Arlan is a holy man of the old faith of the far west of the land of the English. The old tales of the place name him a saint. Yet his day does not sit in the list of the church. The people of the south-west of the land keep his name in the tales of the eve of the year.

attributes.attribute: holy man of the old faith of the west of England

key_results: Set the man in the west of the land.
